proposals.rationale: Correct spec, buggy code. FR-021 requires accurate min/max/mean latency telemetry and SC-006 requires accurate TelemetrySnapshot values. The 2026-08-07 fix was only partially landed: the three sync paths (src/actor.rs:332,397,637) and the blocking wait_for_cqe completion site (src/actor.rs:718) correctly capture a submission Instant and record start.elapsed(), but the primary async-completion path harvest_completions() still calls record_op(0, op.bytes) with a hardcoded 0 even though InflightOp carries a populated `start: Instant` (src/actor.rs:101, set at 480/554). Async ReadAsync/WriteAsync ops record 0 ns latency, driving min_latency_ns to 0 and skewing the mean. The code violates a correct, agreed requirement, so per policy this is an ALIGN task (no source edited). Single task covers both FR-021 and SC-006 (same root cause).
proposals.before: FR-021 text unchanged (requirement is correct as written). Header Last-Synced note (2026-08-07) incorrectly asserted the telemetry defect was fully fixed and 'those requirements now hold as written'.
proposals.after: FR-021 text unchanged. Header Last-Synced note corrected to state the fix is partial: sync paths + wait_for_cqe fixed, harvest_completions still records 0 ns for async ops, so FR-021/SC-006 do NOT hold for async IO; residual defect tracked as an ALIGN task. No source code changed.

proposals.rationale: Working, intentional feature absent from the spec. process_command handles Command::FlushSync { ns_id }: for ns_id==1 it returns Completion::FlushDone{Ok(())} as a validated no-op (device is O_DIRECT|O_DSYNC, no volatile write cache to drain); ns_id!=1 returns InvalidNamespace. The kernel spec never mentioned FlushSync. Backfilled as a new FR parallel to block-device-filesys FR-022.
proposals.before: No requirement mentioning FlushSync. US2 acceptance scenarios ended at scenario 4 (NsProbe).
proposals.after: New FR-027 documenting FlushSync as a validated no-op justified by O_DIRECT|O_DSYNC durability, with ns_id!=1 -> InvalidNamespace; contrasted with filesys FR-022's real fdatasync. New US2 acceptance scenario 5 exercising FlushSync{ns_id:1} -> FlushDone(Ok) and ns_id!=1 -> InvalidNamespace.
